If you use **Wix to build your website**, you can **[add online forms](/plugins/wix-forms/)**. This is a good way to get leads. It also helps you **gather feedback **and manage event sign-ups.

Many people find it hard to choose a form builder. They want one that helps them design attractive forms. The forms should match their brand and convert visitors into customers.

This article will help you learn how to create and manage online forms. You will also see how to customize their design and layout. Finally, you will find out how to add them to your Wix web page easily. 

By the end, you will be able to publish a fully embedded form that blends seamlessly into your site and supports your business goals.

## Why Add Online Forms to Your Wix Website?
**[Online forms](/templates/)** are more than just a way to collect information. When done right, they can:

- Capture qualified leads directly from your website

- Track prospects and manage follow-ups after someone submits a form

- Streamline registrations, surveys, and feedback collection

- Make your site more interactive and professional

- Save time with automation and integrations

Instead of using limited or premade forms with few options, you can rely on Formester. With it, you can make custom forms. You can add rules that change based on answers. You can publish your form as a standalone or embed it on your Wix site.

### Step 1: Create a Landing Page in Wix
Before you add your form, you’ll need a dedicated page where the form will live. In Wix:

- Log in to your site dashboard.

- Create a new page (or edit an existing landing page).

- Decide which section of the page will host your form.

Put your form in a good spot to get the most attention. You can place it at the top of the page or after an important service description.

### Step 2: Build a Form in Formester
Next, create your form. With Formester, you can generate forms instantly **[using AI](/ai-form-generator/)**. For example, type **“create a contact us form,”** and your form is ready in seconds.

**From there, you can:**

- Add essential form fields like name, email, and phone number

- Include advanced features such as add conditional rules or response limits

- Set up email alerts when someone submits a form

This approach saves time while giving you the flexibility to create and manage forms that suit your exact needs.

### Step 3: Customize the Design and Layout
A consistent design and layout makes your form feel like part of your website. To do this:

- In the Wix editor, double-click on text elements to note the font style and size.

- Apply the same style in your Formester form under the design tab.

- Copy your button color from Wix and update the button styling in Formester.

When you use form pages or embed a form, matching your site’s style builds trust and improves user experience.

### Step 4: Embed the Form in Wix
When your form is ready, it’s time to add it to your site. You can use either the embed code or the Formester Wix app.

**Here’s how with the app:**

- Publish your form in Formester.

- Go to the Import tab and select Wix.

- Install the app, which opens your Wix content management system.

- From the editor, click the plus (+) icon, select App Widgets, and choose Formester.

- Paste your form code or URL into the widget.

You can now resize and move the form anywhere on your web page. If you prefer, you can even keep it as a standalone form and link to it directly.

### Step 5: Publish and Test
Finally, click Publish in Wix to make your changes live. Then submit a test entry to make sure your form submission appears correctly in the Formester dashboard. You’ll be able to view and manage every entry, export results, or trigger automated workflows.

### Final Thoughts
Embedding online forms in Wix is easy once you know the steps. With **[Formester](/)**, you get more than just basic forms, you get customizable, branded, and high-converting solutions. If you want to collect information, run surveys, or capture leads, an embedded form on your Wix site can help. It will engage visitors and grow your business.

Ready to get started? Build a form with AI in seconds, create and manage responses with ease, and transform your Wix site into a powerful lead-generation tool.
